title: App Maintenance Cost UK: What It Really Costs to Keep an App Running (2026)
meta_title: App Maintenance Cost UK 2026: Monthly Prices Explained
meta_description: Keeping an app running in the UK costs £149 to £1,495 a month on a care plan, plus store and hosting fees. What's included and how to budget for it.
keywords: how much does it cost to maintain an app

faq.q: How much does it cost to maintain an app in the UK?
faq.a: Expect £149 to £1,495 a month for a care plan, plus £79 a year for Apple, a one-off $25 for Google Play, and hosting.

faq.q: What is a good annual budget for app maintenance?
faq.a: A common rule of thumb is 15 to 20 per cent of the original build cost each year.

faq.q: Do I need to update my app every year?
faq.a: Yes. New iOS and Android versions arrive every year, and apps that aren't updated can stop working or be removed from the stores.

faq.q: Can someone else maintain an app another agency built?
faq.a: Usually, yes. A new provider reviews the code and access first, then takes it onto a care plan.

faq.q: Is hosting included in app maintenance?
faq.a: It depends on the plan. ContentFellow's App Care includes hosting for small apps; check the limits with any provider.
